seoDescription: Thank you for submitting your project brief. We review every brief carefully and respond with a tailored proposal within 24 hours.
heading: We've received your project brief.
description: Thank you for getting in touch. Your requirements have been safely delivered to our production desk. We review every brief carefully and will get back to you with a tailored scope within 24 hours.
phase1Desc: We assess your target dates, creative requirements, filming locations, and turnaround expectations.
phase2Desc: We prepare a tailored production treatment with equipment specs, crew allocation, and clear itemized costing.
phase3Desc: Upon approval, dates are secured in our shoot calendar and pre-production commences immediately.
